set questions to ["Capital of France?", "How many legs does a spider have?", "Biggest planet?"]
set answers to ["Paris", "8", "Jupiter"]
set score to 0
set n to 1
for each q in questions:
  ask q into reply
  if reply is item n of answers:
    say "Correct!"
    change score by 1
  else:
    say "Oops, it was " + item n of answers
  end
  change n by 1
end
say "You scored " + score + " out of " + length of questions

# Recipes are your own instructions
define greet(name):
  say "Hi " + name + "!"
end

define double(n):
  give back n * 2
end

define square(size):
  repeat 4 times:
    forward size
    turn right 90
  end
end
